responsibility: Implements the main AVX-512BW intrinsic header for byte and word AVX-512 operations, including mask-register utilities that become available with this subextension. It defines 512-bit byte/halfword vector aliases and the __mmask64 type, then provides a broad API for k-test/kortest helpers, mask arithmetic and conversions, byte/word shifts, shuffles, blends, and comparisons, making it the core byte/word companion to the baseline AVX-512F header.
